title: Why Can't I See My Clusters? A Precision-Recall Approach to Dimensionality Reduction Validation
abstract: arXiv:2509.04222v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Dimensionality Reduction (DR) is widely used for visualizing high-dimensional data, often with the goal of revealing expected cluster structure. However, such a structure may not always appear in the projections. Existing DR quality metrics assess projection reliability (to some extent) or cluster structure quality, but do not explain why expected structures are missing. Visual Analytics solutions can help, but are often time-consuming due to the large hyperparameter space. This paper addresses this problem by leveraging a recent framework that divides the DR process into two phases: a relationship phase, where similarity relationships are modeled, and a mapping phase, where the data is projected accordingly. translated_title: 为什么我看不到我的聚类？一种用于降维验证的精确率-召回率方法
translated_abstract: 降维（DR）被广泛用于可视化高维数据，通常旨在揭示预期的聚类结构。然而，这种结构可能并不总是出现在投影中。现有的DR质量指标评估投影可靠性（在一定程度上）或聚类结构质量，但无法解释为什么预期结构缺失。视觉分析解决方案可以提供帮助，但由于超参数空间庞大，通常耗时。本文通过利用一个近期框架来解决此问题，该框架将DR过程分为两个阶段：关系阶段（建模相似性关系）和映射阶段（相应地投影数据）。我们引入了两个监督指标，精确率和召回率，用于评估关系阶段。这些指标量化了建模的关系与基于某些标签集所预期的聚类结构之间的对齐程度。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于精确率和召回率的监督指标，用于评估降维关系阶段，从而解释预期聚类结构为何在投影中缺失。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces supervised precision and recall metrics to evaluate the relationship phase of dimensionality reduction, explaining why expected cluster structures are missing in projections.
